name: ExecuteOperationASync

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Architect Design Tools (CADT) application
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set this parameter to ecs to modify ECS-related parameters
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，如果需要修改ecs的相关参数请填写：ecs
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the current operation used to modify a product. Some operation types are universal, while others are dedicated.
The following examples show the operation types for ECS:
ECS instance name: rename
ECS instance type: modifyInstanceType
Start an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Stop an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Restart an ECS instance: modifyInstanceType
Add tags to an ECS instance: addTags
Delete an ECS instance: ecsDelete
ECS billing method: modifyPayType
parameters.help_zh:
本次操作类型，是修改产品的操作类型，有的操作类型是通用，有的是单独使用。
下面为ecs的相关编配示例：
ecs的名称：rename
ecs的规格：modifyInstanceType
ecs的启动：modifyInstanceType
ecs的停止：modifyInstanceType
ecs的重启：modifyInstanceType
ecs添加标签：addTags
ecs的删除：ecsDelete
ecs的付费类型：modifyPayType
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The parameters related to the operation. Specify the corresponding parameters based on the value of the Operation parameter. The parameters are passed as a map.
The following examples show how to modify the specifications of an ECS instance:
Common parameters required for ECS:
change_type,
regionId,
instanceId,
appId
Example of parameter values for modifying the instance type of an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_instance_type\",\"instance_type\":\"ecs.hfr7.2xlarge\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example of stopping an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Stopped\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example of starting an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Running\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
Example of restarting an ECS instance:
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Restart\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
parameters.help_zh:
操作相关参数，根据不同的Operation值，输入对应的参数，此次传值是以map的形式传参。
以下为ecs的变配为例：
ecs的需要传递的公共参数如下：
change_type,
regionId,
instanceId,
appId
ecs变更规格的参数值示例：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_instance_type\",\"instance_type\":\"ecs.hfr7.2xlarge\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs停止实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Stopped\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs启动的参数实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Running\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
ecs重启的实例如下：
{
"ServiceType": "ecs",
"Operation": "modifyInstanceType",
"Attributes": "{\"change_type\":\"modify_status\",\"status\":\"Restart\",\"instanceId\":\"i-xxxxxxxxx\",\"regionId\":\"cn-beijing\",\"appId\":\"xxxxxxxxxxxxx\"}"
}
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，用于资源组权限校验

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success, whereas other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 结果码，200代表成功；其它代表失败
Code.title_zh: 结果码，200代表成功；其它代表失败。

Data.description_zh: OperationId，可通过GetExecuteOperationResult这个api异步获取操作结果。（有效时间为 1 小时）
